senses.gloss:
दोग्धृ m. [दुह्-तृच्]
—1 A cowherd, a milk-man; मेरौ स्थिते दोग्धरि दोहदक्षे Ku. 1. 2.
—2 A calf.
—3 A panegyrist, one who writes verses for hire or reward.
—4 One who performs anything out of interested motives (with a view to
 profit himself).

—1 A cow which yields milk.
—2 A wet-nurse (having much milk; Mar. दाइ).
—3 A female who gives anything (with acc.).
